frequency_question: How often do announced union strike ballots in the banking sector culminate in an actual initiated indefinite strike rather than a settlement or postponement within the target window?
membership_rule: Includes industry-wide strike calls by federation coalitions in the banking sector involving formal notices of dispute; excludes localized single-bank strikes or non-indefinite (one-day) token strikes.
coverage_note: 8 named major strike call cycles in the Indian banking sector since 2020; 1 resulted in actual indefinite/extended strike action, while 7 were averted through conciliation settlements or deferred.
known_gaps: Minor local affiliate protests not tracked at the national UFBU federation level.
validity_reason: Labor union negotiation dynamics and conciliation frameworks in the sector evolve slowly over multi-year legislative cycles.
